region.finding: All 24 enlarged source/battle head/body slices actually inspected, with original source heads plus brightness-2.5 analysis copies. Eyes, hood, ears, tunic/belt, arms/hands, legs/feet and complete tail remain coherent. Subtle lower mask/jaw-edge flex retains neck/chest/arm weights and independently fails in both assets. Correct this residual while preserving the full character sculpt and animation curves.

All 24 enlarged source/battle head/body animation slices actually inspected at brightness 2.5. Lower muzzle, lip/chin, side cheek and whisker roots compress and pull during recoil, jump, attack and defeat. Mixed neck/chest/spine/upper-arm influences remain across the lower face. Preserve eyes, pink nose, ears, riveted headband/tails, scarf, tunic/wraps, back sword, arms/hands, legs/feet, body and complete tail.

All 24 enlarged source/battle head/body slices actually inspected at brightness 2.5. Beak and eyes remain stable, but lower white face and side jaw retain neck/chest influence and fold into the throat during alternate idle, recoil and terminal defeat. Complete the exposed lower face binding while retaining flexible throat/chest feathers, wing articulation, headband/tails, legs, talons and entire tail.

All 24 enlarged baseline source/battle head/body slices actually inspected at brightness 2.5. Beak and lower central face stay stable, but side cheek/eye rim retains wing/chest influences and pulls toward the raised wing in alternate idle and recoil. Refined lower beak/cheek landmarks separate the naturally flexible throat bib and shoulder feathers; retain original attachment markers as diagnostic evidence. Repair cheek binding while preserving crest, wrapped headband/tails, central lightning bib, wing articulation, orange chest, feet/talons and full tail.

All 24 enlarged source/battle head/body slices actually inspected at brightness 2.5. Lower lip, chin and side jaw compress and stretch during alternate idle, jump, recoil and defeat; a flattened mouth strip projects out through the scarf in terminal defeat. Eyes, upper face, headband/tails, shell, four legs, wraps, claws and tail otherwise remain coherent. Repair full lower face while retaining scarf articulation and original sculpt.
